name: Prompt → animated 3D character (GPT → video → Tripo → Blender agent)
description: Prompt → GPT Image concept art → AI video of the motion → Tripo 3D model → a local GPT agent drives Blender through Blender MCP: imports the model, rigs it and recreates the animation from the video frames, then exports an animated GLB.

params.name: prompt
params.value: a stylized fantasy knight with a round shield

params.name: animation
params.value: walks forward confidently, full body visible, camera static

params.prompt: Full-body game character concept, {{inputs.prompt}}. Neutral A-pose, front view, whole body in frame, plain light-grey background, even lighting, no shadows, no text.
The character {{workflow.animation}}. Keep the same design, plain background, static camera.

In Blender (via your tools):
1. Clear the default scene, then import the 3D model from the input model path.
2. Scale it to about 1.8 m tall, standing on the ground, facing -Y.
3. Add a humanoid armature (Rigify basic human or a simple custom skeleton), fit it to the mesh and bind with automatic weights.
4. Study the reference frames (input files) of this motion: "{{workflow.animation}}". Create a looping 2-second action that reproduces it with keyframes on the bones.
5. Take a viewport screenshot to check the pose.
6. Export the result as animated GLB (include the armature and animation) into the output folder, and also save the .blend there.
Use Python code execution in Blender when a dedicated tool is missing.
